registry_hash_policy: Review the registry at the implementation checkpoint. Bind the working registry to the final signed source. Exclude it from file_sha256 so registering the approval does not create a self-hash cycle.
changes: B-4A: register the fixed input decision, read the versioned PREPARED candidate from Git, verify its exact REVIEWED transition and inherited inputs.
B-4B: bind the implementation review snapshot, reviewed code and registry evidence to the signed review checkpoint and require its ancestry at the final signed HEAD.
B-4B: choose the canonical Notices path from the supported version, verify reviewed metadata and bytes against the formal audit result, and keep the ZIP member name fixed.
Existing Package, independent Verifier, Compile provenance and Privacy helpers are included in the reviewed scope; B-2 candidate tooling and relevant line-ending attributes are included.
excluded_scope: Formal Compile, Package or Independent Verifier results
